title: PROCESIO Credential config
description: Create/edit a credential instance for a connection template. 'template' is the type name (e.g. 'REST API', 'Outbound e-mail (SMTP)', 'SQL'); 'properties' maps property labels to values (select/radio option NAMES are accepted and resolved to their value).

properties.description: property label (or id) -> value (secrets included here). A value may be an array (e.g. an OAuth2 'Scopes' pills list) or object for structured properties.
